title: Regex, JSON & Dates
intro: Learn the basic ideas of Regex, JSON & Dates in simple English. Read the explanation and example first; the quiz asks only from the concepts taught here.

items.heading: Regex
items.text: Regular expressions are patterns used to search, match or validate text.

items.heading: re module
items.text: Python’s re module provides functions and objects for working with regular expressions.

items.heading: Search
items.text: re.search() looks for a matching pattern and returns a match object when found, otherwise None.

items.heading: Match object
items.text: A regex match object contains information about the part of the text that matched the pattern.

items.heading: Input validation
items.text: Regex can check whether text follows an expected pattern such as a simple code or identifier.

items.heading: JSON
items.text: JSON is a text format commonly used to represent structured data.

items.heading: json module
items.text: Python’s json module converts between JSON text and Python data structures.

items.heading: json.loads()
items.text: json.loads() parses JSON text and returns the corresponding Python data.

items.heading: json.dumps()
items.text: json.dumps() converts Python data into JSON-formatted text.

items.heading: JSON mappings
items.text: A JSON object commonly maps to a Python dictionary, while a JSON array commonly maps to a Python list.

items.heading: datetime
items.text: The datetime module provides classes for working with dates and times.
